calculation.description: When cross-asset daily return dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median, rank assets by the negative one-day return residual to the cross-sectional median, scaled by each asset's 20-day volatility. Outside the high-dispersion regime the signal is missing rather than active.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across tested slices: 2020-22 IC 0.072997/ICIR 0.198117 (448 dates), 2023-24 IC 0.061268/ICIR 0.176231 (336 dates), 2025-26 IC 0.074717/ICIR 0.213524 (321 dates), and 2026-07 onward IC 0.025645/ICIR 0.083800 (197 dates). Latest regime is weaker but remains positive.
validation.admission_gate: absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840
